title: Voltas Beko 268L Frost Free Double Door Refrigerator
description: This 268L frost-free double-door refrigerator has 6-in-1 adjustable modes, NeoFrost dual cooling and hybrid cooling. It includes an internal digital display, a 32L vegetable crisper and toughened glass shelves.

highlights.title: 6-in-1 Adjustable
highlights.subtitle: Adjust between modes effortlessly to suit your needs

highlights.title: NeoFrost Dual Cooling
highlights.subtitle: Two separate cooling circuits for faster and more even cooling

highlights.title: 32L Vegetable Crisper
highlights.subtitle: Storage capacity of up to 32 L
